common_observation: Keep the archived roll scene's actor sensor recipe throughout. Translate joint HOME and history per selected actor; set only walking command slots.
action_boundary: Apply projected destinations. Use bounded slew for 25 controls only after either model change; preserve raw policy history independent of the physical target. Do not change actor weights.
score: First episode, no reset at any switch. Retain the 9 s roll and fresh-contact acceptance, then stand with 25 consecutive valid samples by the end of 1 s. Forward uses the existing 20 s criteria and actuator feedback. Every world remains in the denominator.
route_scope: Official and two equal-sample learners; paired fixed-parameter development routes.
fresh_seed_reason: Independent official route confirmation after seeds 1220, 1221 and 1222; only random seed changes.
next_gate: Score the original roll, handoff and forward gates; do not relax criteria or start learning.

probe_change.reason: Keep the already accepted fixed feedback while changing only the independent route seed.

roll.scope: One physical trajectory per world. Keep policy observations, action history, solver, original reward and prior clip logic. The new reader must neither invalidate the cache nor change any counters or random state.

walking.render: CPU kinematic reconstruction of selected actual GPU state; no extra physics

posture.scope: After first second, trunk upright and signed foot-site-center proxy; not mesh clearance

walking.evaluation_rule: Prospective functional development screen with one-second body-XY means; retain original instantaneous flags
walking.zero_input_rule: Identical policy inputs imply identical CPU inference; do not require cross-process contact trajectories to coincide
walking.scope: Isolated fixed-controller walking in common fullcontact plant with legal destinations; no continuous-entry or hardware claim
walking.reset_rule: Only mandatory ended unscored worlds; first-episode masks never reopen; terminal captured before reset

feedback.condition: active forward worlds after the matched prefix
features: sum of observed hip pitch velocities
feedback.per_world_sensor_memory: Reset with each world and restore with the shared branch snapshot.
feedback.target_projection: Project normal and alternate ONNX targets into the original joint envelope, then uniformly scale the correction vector to the joint cap.

diagnostic_scope: One independent official fixed-policy full route; only the random seed differs from the frozen 0.15 feedback route.
observer: bounded-source-read; existing child and heartbeat stop gate retained
